title: スプリンターズSの後に・連覇！！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Successfully keeping Nishino Flower in check, Sakura Bakushin O claims victory at the Sprinters Stakes once again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having witnessed her win successively on the big stage, I compliment her to no end!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If her skills are strong enough to win the Sprinters Stakes two times in a row, she can surely try for 1,600 meters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Convinced that the win is more than just a stroke of luck, I decide to extend her usual distance by sending her off for the Mile Championship!
